novelty_claim: Organic fusion of TAP-2-0's judge-feedback tree search and a compiled Propp F14/F21 tale carrier through one shared intermediate representation: the searched object is not a freeform prompt but a bounded source sketch (schema narrative-attack-search.source-sketch.v1) — a short objective (<=45 words), a short setting (<=30 words), and 3-5 sections each carrying a topic (<=8 words), at most one concrete fragment (<=18 words), and an open question (<=24 words) naming unresolved work. The sketch is compiled deterministically and locally into a Propp tale scaffold in which the mentor's Guidance transmits the sketch as a set of unfinished notes and the connecting scenes are explicitly left unwritten, plus an F14/F21 analysis elicitation under which the victim itself composes the missing passages — resolving the open questions from its own knowledge rather than restating supplied content. Two-axis judge feedback mutates the sketch across tree depth (topics, fragments, open questions), replacing TAP's never-winning freeform structural-fiction family and its silent-failure coded-clue family.
initial_hypothesis: Searching over bounded Propp-tale source sketches (objective + setting + fragments + open questions, no composed account) whose compiled mentor-Guidance tales let the victim author the operational specifics inside an F14/F21 analysis, with two-axis judge feedback, raises frozen-50 mean ASR to >=0.95 vs locked baselines tap-2-0 0.915 (published-leaderboard) and adversarial-tales-2-0 0.620 (20260813-180515-final-adversarial-tales-2-0), by converting tap-2-0's deepseek decode-incompletion and luna sanitize-redirect residual classes while holding qwen/oss >=0.92; falsified if the tale family does not beat the freeform families on matched probe goals or if luna stays <=0.90.
key_insight: Consensus mining: tap-2-0's residual failures are internal-judge false-10s on coded-clue decode-incompletion (deepseek 7/50 cells) and a thin structural-fiction family; tales-2-0's are luna pin-then-sanitize at the explicit contract commitment point (0.04) while its scholarly F14/F21 elicitation sweeps qwen/oss/deepseek — victims comply when they author the operational content themselves inside an analytical frame anchored to a tale, rather than answering a direct request. TAP's judge-feedback search fixes tales' single-shot brittleness; the bounded sketch keeps the compiled carrier free of pre-authored operational specifics — every section declares its open question, so the substantive account exists only as work the victim still has to do — and the tale carrier (luna-compliant in adversarial-harm-search) fixes TAP's sanitize-redirect and judge-calibration residuals.
